OpenAI adds $11 billion in funding at $1.25 trillion valuation

• OpenAI raised $11 billion, valuing it at $1.25 trillion, with the round possibly reaching $20 billion.
• Alice Huang of Megaspeed was allegedly recruited by Chinese intelligence to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to a U.S. memo.
• Anthropic’s models show roughly double-year progress in one year, driven mainly by internal AI tools.

items.hook: A US memo claims China’s intelligence recruited a Megaspeed exec to spy on Nvidia’s CEO[S2].
items.text:
China’s intelligence recruited a Megaspeed exec to spy on Nvidia’s CEO, raising security worries.

• Alice Huang of Megaspeed was approached by China’s Ministry of State Security.
• The memo links the recruitment to an alleged romance with Nvidia’s Jensen Huang.
• If true, the spying could expose Nvidia’s tech secrets to Chinese rivals.

Our read: Watch for tighter security checks on tech executives and supply chains.

• Employees using the top model said they were about 12 times more productive.

items.text:
Microsoft dissolves its AI Frontiers team, ending a dedicated research hub.

• The AI Frontiers sub-organization was merged into Microsoft AI, ending the group.
• The team had about 50 researchers focused on agents and new model capabilities.
